rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration was a pure refactor + a CORS spec compliance fix. The CORS bug was a silent client-side rejection of /api/auth/me responses that combined Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true (spec violation per W3C CORS — browsers MUST ignore the response on credentialed requests). Fix: drop allow_credentials=True (frontend doesn't use cookies; auth is via Authorization: Bearer JWT) AND keep wildcard for the dev preview while supporting an explicit FRONTEND_ORIGINS env var for production. Verified: cross-origin GET /api/auth/me now returns 200 with correct headers, body matches user object.
